subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands holds a coach's clipboard and whistle on the sidelines of a youth practice. The left hand grips the clipboard showing a simple play diagram of circles and arrows, while the right hand raises a whistle mid-blow — the encouraging, high-energy instant before a team huddle. A soccer ball rests at the corner, grounding the scene in grassroots sport.
